text: The historical CloseDatabase implementation closes this folder database, or asks the database service to close this folder, while ForceDBClosed iterates subfolders. FolderCompactor switches to the single-folder call; the fixed consumer still calls CloseDatabase after its start notification. Similar names do not imply the same recursion scope. Required Bug comments remain unavailable; this is source-only, not a proven compaction fix or an exhaustive current-native implementation review. No database test ran.
title: Single-folder database closure differs from recursive ForceDBClosed
